description_en: Deletes whitelist IPs for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 删除针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo delete-auto-cc-whitelist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --whitelist src_:_1.1.1.1_,_src_:_2.2.2.2 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAutoCcWhitelist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The details of the whitelist IP, expressed as a JSON string with the following structure.
src: String type, required, the whitelist IP
parameters.help_zh:
白名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
src：String类型，必选，白名单IP
parameters.name: whitelist
